summary: Firefox’s compositing and scrolling updates improve how gestures, overscroll, and scroll-driven animations behave, including when scrolling hands off between page areas. They also strengthen protected DRM video handling on macOS and HDR color on Linux Wayland, and add support for the WebRTC video-orientation extension used to signal a camera’s rotation during a call. Other fixes improve Android graphics, WebGL/WebGPU surfaces, and browser responsiveness around the software keyboard.
